en.title: String After Repeatedly Deleting AWS
en.description:
Repeatedly delete AWS from an uppercase string, joining the two sides of each deletion, until AWS no longer appears; output −1 if the result is empty.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: One line with a string of uppercase English letters, of length 1..100000.
en.output: Output the final string; output −1 if it is empty.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: G; -1; S. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Push characters onto a stack one by one, and whenever the stack ends with AWS, delete those three characters.
